---
title: Scholar metadata for a top-level array YAML bibliography
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references-array.yaml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_title=Formatted reference;"][content*="citation_volume=1.10;"][content*="citation_issue=7;"]']
---

The bibliography is a YAML file holding a top-level list of references, with no `references:` key, which pandoc accepts for `--bibliography`. The fields still go through pandoc's YAML reader: the markdown title is parsed and the unquoted volume keeps its text.

This article cites one work [@cited].
